title: Twain - Bodybuilding - Improvement phase 2
author: Twain T.
desc: My bodybuilding program designed to help improve overall lower body and back size, specifically targeting improved hamstrings, glutes, teres, lats, and spinal erectors. Generally good for any intermediate lifter looking to improve these specific areas, but has adequate volume for the whole physique.
